title: Great Hall Of Celeano
wikitext:
This [[Other World]] Location is a great library containing many stolen texts of the Elder Gods by the Old Ones. It is located on the fourth planet orbiting the star of the same name.

==Mythos Source==
Celeano is first mentioned in ''The House on Curwen Street'' (1944), written by August Derleth.
